case_decisions.rationale: Four facts match the full general source: team purpose/collaboration, three connected goals, transition with targeted fixes, and weekly design/knowledge-sharing meetings. Related project minutes do not independently supply the complete charter and meeting-purpose facts. Korean wording is natural and requires English-source interpretation.

Five facts distinguish expiry of the bounded exception, normal duration, extension conditions and validity, and the actual one-ready/one-pending returned-kit state. Both alternative sources for the reversion fact are retained. Numeric rules require the general document and the observed return state requires the later meeting, so every full sufficient alternative needs multiple documents. English wording refers unambiguously to the fictional institution.

The five required statements and their temporal qualifications are supported, and both dated meetings are necessary. However V03-F2 omits two independent sufficient locations from the same later source. Reject this item for alternative completeness only; truth, language, query wording, status and existing coordinate bindings pass.

The five facts correctly separate initial two-bag trial approval, observed attachment/confusion, later future replacement with owner/deadline, scope for other bags, and kit-content limits. Both dated meetings are required for the complete chronology. Romanization variants for the named fictional assignee are allowed.

All three requested amounts are absent from the full corpus. Later replacement-cost uncertainty and the general exclusion of prices/compensation/travel amounts support the boundary; no unrelated source supplies amounts. Optional context is not required, and unknown does not mean zero or borrower fault.

The full public family contains a conditional future official-model intention but no adopted release, actual adoption date or approved RFC number. Unrelated fictional sources supply none. Abstention is limited to these records and does not claim that adoption never occurred externally.

The full sources show a proposed driver, a separate implementation intention and goals for portions of a test suite. They give no final driver assignee, actual introduction date or measured entire-suite pass rate. Issue numbers, a planned Wednesday and stated intentions are not substituted for the requested outcomes.

The later fictional meeting defers guide release until approval and defers the next institution/dispatch until reservations are settled. Earlier shipment and draft/tag deadlines do not supply those missing values. A concise English abstention covering all three requested slots is sufficient.
